verdict_reason: New VersionId tests cover increment and carry-forward well, but omit NOTIFICATION_EDITED, which production treats as a no-versionId event including after submission.

todos.issue: VersionId nested class covers CREATED and DELETED as no-versionId events but omits NOTIFICATION_EDITED, which OutboxService.NO_VERSION_ID_EVENTS also includes (including amend-phase page saves after a submission).
todos.fix: Add a VersionId test that appends NOTIFICATION_EDITED (DRAFT, and AMEND after a stubbed submission count) and asserts exchangedDocument does not contain versionId.
